mechanic.rateComparison: About half of what most shops around Knoxville charge for labor.

referral.headline: Bring me work, take 10% of the labor
referral.body: If you send someone my way and the job goes through, 10% of the labor on that job is yours. Not the parts — the labor. Paid once the customer settles up. It works for anyone: other shops, detailers, tow drivers, or a neighbor who told a neighbor.

jobs.name: Brakes
jobs.description: Pads, rotors, calipers, lines and fluid. One of the most common calls.

jobs.name: Suspension & steering
jobs.description: Struts, shocks, control arms, ball joints, tie rods, bushings and wheel bearings.

jobs.name: Starting & charging
jobs.description: Batteries, starters, alternators, and tracking down what is draining the battery.

jobs.name: Cooling system
jobs.description: Radiators, water pumps, thermostats, hoses and overheating problems.

jobs.name: Belts, hoses & leaks
jobs.description: Serpentine belts, tensioners, and finding where the fluid is actually coming from.

jobs.name: Routine maintenance
jobs.description: Oil and filter changes, fluid services, plugs, and general upkeep.

jobs.name: Check-engine diagnosis
jobs.description: Pulling codes is the easy part. Working out what the code is actually telling you is the job.

promises.title: Call before you haul it over
promises.body: I do not have the equipment for every job on every vehicle. Call during business hours, tell me what is going on, and I will tell you straight away whether it is something I can take on — or point you somewhere that can. That is a two-minute call that saves you an afternoon.

promises.title: One rate, no games
promises.body: Labor is one flat hourly rate. No diagnostic tier, no shop-supply percentage tacked on at the end, no different number because of what you drive. You pay for the time the job actually takes.

promises.title: Honest and fair, every time
promises.body: If a repair is not worth doing, I will say so. If I get into it and it turns out to be less work than quoted, the bill reflects that. If something is beyond what I can do properly, I will tell you rather than guess at it. That matters more to me than any single job.
